description:
## Why This Exists

post/ipfs_write.rs::MemIpfsStore uses HashMap<Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>> keyed by cid.to_bytes(). The Cid type from the cid crate implements Hash and Eq, so HashMap<Cid, Vec<u8>> is directly usable. Using Vec<u8> as the key adds allocation on every lookup (cid.to_bytes() allocates).

## Acceptance Criteria

Change MemIpfsStore.blocks type to HashMap<Cid, Vec<u8>>.
title: Rust idiom: MemIpfsStore key is cid.to_bytes() Vec<u8> — should use Cid directly as key
